name: Exp_Extrem_N
summary: This EA trades based on the Extrem_N custom indicator, which identifies market extremums (peaks and troughs). It opens buy positions when an up-signal appears after a down-signal and sell positions when a down-signal appears after an up-signal, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Extrem_N自定义指标进行交易，该指标识别市场极值（波峰和波谷）。当下行信号后出现上行信号时开多仓，当上行信号后出现下行信号时开空仓，并可配置止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Extrem_N自定义指标来识别市场极值点作为交易信号。入场条件：当指标的上行缓冲区在信号柱上出现非零值且前一个柱有下行信号时，开多仓；当指标的下行缓冲区在信号柱上出现非零值且前一个柱有上行信号时，开空仓。出场条件通过固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）实现，同时支持根据反向信号平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1手固定手数模式。策略采用新柱检测机制避免同一柱重复交易，并使用历史加载函数确保数据完整性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Extrem_N custom indicator to identify market extremum points as trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upper buffer shows a non-zero value on the signal bar and the previous bar had a down signal; a sell position is opened when the lower buffer shows a non-zero value and the previous bar had an up signal. Exit conditions are implemented through fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), with additional support for closing positions on reverse signals. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin after loss, by balance after loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots in fixed lot mode. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades on the same bar and uses a history loading function to ensure data completeness.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易手数或风险比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：按自由保证金/余额/亏损后自由保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: Free margin/Balance/Net margin/Net balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Signal detection bar index (0 = current bar)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于极值反转信号进行交易，具有明确的入场和出场规则
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
支持独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓，交易控制粒度细致
使用新柱检测机制避免同一K线重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈比例2:1，具有正期望收益的潜在优势
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on extremum reversal signals with well-defined entry and exit rules
Five position sizing modes available, flexible for different risk preferences
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing provides fine-grained trade management
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 2:1 offers potential positive expectancy
cons: 依赖自定义指标Extrem_N，指标逻辑不透明，无法独立验证信号质量
止损1000点和止盈2000点较大，可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
没有持仓数量检查，可能在不同信号下重复开仓
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印警告但EA继续运行，可能导致无信号交易
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator Extrem_N whose internal logic is opaque, making signal quality unverifiable independently
Stop loss of 1000 and take profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
No spread filter or trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
No position count check, may repeatedly open positions on different signals
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a warning but EA continues running, potentially trading without signals
improvements: 增加持仓数量检查，防止同方向重复开仓导致风险集中
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在不利条件下入场
指标句柄创建失败时应在OnInit中返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行
增加动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR或波动率调整而非固定点数
improvements_en: Add position count checks to prevent repeated same-direction entries causing concentrated risk
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid entering under unfavorable conditions
Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when indicator handle creation fails instead of continuing to run
Implement dynamic stop loss and take profit based on ATR or volatility rather than fixed point values

risk_points: 指标句柄创建失败时EA仍继续运行但无法获取信号，可能导致异常行为
没有持仓数量限制，多信号下可能累积过多仓位
固定止损1000点较大，在高杠杆下可能造成显著亏损
缺少点差过滤，可能在点差扩大时仍执行交易
risk_points_en: EA continues running when indicator handle creation fails but cannot obtain signals, potentially causing abnormal behavior
No position count limit, may accumulate excessive positions on multiple signals
Fixed stop loss of 1000 points is large and may cause significant losses with high leverage
No spread filter, may execute trades even when spreads widen
